passage:
The school replaced plastic student cards with digital IDs on phones. Many students liked not carrying cards.
But problems appeared quickly. Some students had dead batteries. Some did not own smartphones. One student felt uncomfortable showing his personal phone at the gate.
The school brought back plastic cards as an option.
Administrators learned that "digital first" should not mean "digital only."
A school system must work for all students, not only the easiest group to serve. Modernization is good when it expands access. It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.
